import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

Do not implement, suggest, report, or propose security issues unless the user explicitly asks for a security review.
Inspect the OpenCode implementation at `/Users/igor/Documents/ChatGPT/opencode` and [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) for related requests.

## Wiki index

- [OpenCode workflow](wiki/opencode.md)
- [Test OpenCode execution](wiki/opencode-v2-experiment.md)
- [Oh My Github App](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/oh-my-github-app.md)

- [Testing and verification](wiki/testing.md)
- [OmGithub publishing](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/omgithub.md)


## Main project file

The main project file is [.github/workflows/opencode.yml](.github/workflows/opencode.yml).

Keep the local [game issue E2E skill](.agents/skills/game-issue-e2e/SKILL.md)
aligned with this workflow. Create an issue with `OpenCode` and only user-requested mode labels already attached, to start the native `issues.opened` listener. Wait only for the
initial OpenCode session link during E2E kickoff. Install the listener on the
default branch before requesting execution. Validate author access and freeze
the request inside Actions before starting the reusable execution job.
Set repository variable `OPENCODE_ACCESS=everyone` to accept any issue author
for labeled issues. Keep the App as a setup
helper. Use Actions concurrency to serialize each issue.
Store `branch` in an `omgithub-request:v1` JSON HTML comment to select the
project checkout, result base, and workflow. Let default-branch preparation
dispatch the selected branch. Run preparation and OpenCode in that branch run.

## Shell timing

When writing shell scripts,
always add explicit per-command execution-time measurements between commands.
Use `/usr/bin/time -p` or a small timing helper around each meaningful command;
the outer command duration is not sufficient because it hides which step is
slow or hung. Use `/usr/bin/time` only in scripts; do not invoke it directly in
interactive shell commands.

## Ideas

Store durable implementation ideas as individual Markdown files under
`./ideas/`, using descriptive kebab-case filenames such as
`ideas/opencode-oauth-env-auth.md`.




## Links in handoffs

When a relevant URL or stable identifier exists, include a clickable Markdown
link in the user-facing response. Link GitHub issues, Actions runs, pull
requests, commits, releases, public app URLs, and Codex tasks/threads rather
than reporting only their numbers or plain text. For Codex tasks/threads, use
the `codex://threads/<thread-id>` URL format.

When mentioning a commit, append its relative age in hours or days.

## OpenCode GitHub Actions

To execute an issue, create it with `OpenCode` and only mode labels explicitly requested by the user.
Check for a native `issues` run and successful preparation.
The workflow starts a temporary AgentsWeb SSH session,
verifies it, runs OpenCode, and cleans up the SSH session afterward.

When monitoring a triggered run, use `gh run watch <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --exit-status` for overall job status.
Do not use `gh run view --log` to read logs from a running task: GitHub reports that
logs are unavailable until completion. Use `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>`
for the live Actions log over SSH. Do not use tight `for` loops around `gh run list`,
which needlessly consume GitHub API rate limit.

Free OpenCode models are limited per egress IP, not per account.
Treat a local `FreeUsageLimitError` 429 as local only.
Read the runner's own `Selected model` and provider errors before blaming quota.
Use `retryAfterMs` as the reset bound.
Run repeated V2 tests with a connected provider; do not spend the free allowance on retries.

Interrupting a V2 turn before the assistant message projects leaves no stopped message to save.

## Objective
- Build a browser game “Weed Firm” (German user request): grow, sell, multiple pots, seeds, fertilizer, level system, with fast unlocks, similar to the Weed Firm mobile game and the provided strain-list screenshot.

## Requirements
- German clarification: “Weed anbauen, verkaufen, verschiedene Töpfe, Samen Dünger usw level system nicht zu lange zeit bis ingame updates freigeschaltet werden.”
- Second clarification: “Verschiedene sorten als beispiel” with reference image listing strains such as Afghan Kush, AK-47, Blueberry, Blue Dream, Bubba Kush, Gelato, Gorilla Glue #4, Northern Lights, OG Kush, Sour Diesel, White Widow, Zkittlez, etc.
- Must feel like the screenshot: room with pots on benches, grow lights, level XP counter, cash and bud counters.
- Keep unlocks brisk; first new strains within the first minute.
- Mobile + desktop playable; touch-friendly, responsive.

## Decisions
- Built a polished Three.js 3D grow room instead of a 2D copy, with procedural plants, strain-colored buds, neon “WEED FIRM” sign, LED bars, dust, glow effects.
- Vanilla static HTML/CSS/JS (no package.json to avoid Vite detection); Three.js vendored locally at `vendor/three.module.js`.
- 6 pots total, 3 unlocked initially; 32 strains with THC %, type, effect, tray cost, grow time, yield, price/g.
- Quick XP curve: levels 2/3 reachable within a few harvests; strains unlock at levels 1–16.
- Seeds inventory plus auto-buy on plant; Bloom Booster fertilizer consumable; upgrades: LED Array, Nutrient Line, Smart Pots, Security, Genetics Lab.
- Heat/raid system, market multipliers every 7s, localStorage autosave/offline growth.
- Start overlay button label exactly “Start” so automated capture can click it.
- Game logic isolated in `src/game.js` for testability.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game logic/economy in `src/game.js` (strains, XP, seeds, fertilizer, pods, market, heat, raids, save state).
- Three.js scene in `src/scene.js` (room, 6 pots, tables, plants, buds, LED lights, sign, particles, markers projection, responsive camera/layout).
- UI/controller in `src/ui.js`, panel HTML builders in `src/panels.js`, icons in `src/icons.js`, WebAudio SFX in `src/audio.js`.

- Latest desktop screenshot shows plant leaves almost white-green, oversized bud blobs, weak pot/table presence, and left pod partially clipped at screen edge.
- Mobile screenshot (previous iteration) also needs re-check after camera/lighting changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Re-inspect latest `screenshots/final-desktop.png` and `screenshots/final-mobile.png`.
2. Fix plant look: darker/saturated green leaves, reduce leaf width/overlap, make buds smaller and more clustered, reduce emissive/lighting washout, ensure buds read as dense nugs not blobs.

## Objective
- Build a browser game “Weed Firm” (German user request): grow, sell, multiple pots, seeds, fertilizer, level system, with fast unlocks, similar to the Weed Firm mobile game and the provided strain-list screenshot.

## Requirements
- German clarification: “Weed anbauen, verkaufen, verschiedene Töpfe, Samen Dünger usw level system nicht zu lange zeit bis ingame updates freigeschaltet werden.”
- Second clarification: “Verschiedene sorten als beispiel” with reference image listing strains such as Afghan Kush, AK-47, Blueberry, Blue Dream, Bubba Kush, Gelato, Gorilla Glue #4, Northern Lights, OG Kush, Sour Diesel, White Widow, Zkittlez, etc.
- Newest requirement: “ingame Sprache Deutsch” — all in-game UI text must be German.
- Must feel like the screenshot: room with pots on benches, grow lights, level XP counter, cash and bud counters.
- Keep unlocks brisk; first new strains within the first minute.
- Mobile + desktop playable; touch-friendly, responsive.

## Decisions
- Polished Three.js 3D grow room (not a 2D copy) with procedural plants, strain-colored buds, neon “WEED FIRM” sign, LED bars, dust, glow effects.
- Vanilla static HTML/CSS/JS; Three.js vendored locally at `vendor/three.module.js`.
- 6 pots total, 3 unlocked initially; 32 strains with THC %, type, effect, tray cost, grow time, yield, price/g.
- Quick XP curve: levels 2/3 reachable within a few harvests; strains unlock at levels 1–16.
- Seeds inventory plus auto-buy on plant; Blüte-Booster fertilizer consumable; upgrades: LED-Array, Nährstoff-Linie, Smart Pots, Sicherheit, Genetik-Labor.
- Heat/raid system, market multipliers every 7s, localStorage autosave/offline growth.
- Start overlay button label exactly “Start” (German and required by automated capture).
- Game logic isolated in `src/game.js` for testability.
- German UI uses “GELD”, “VORRAT”, “HITZE”, tabs “ANBAU / SAMEN / MARKT / AUSBAU”; money formatted `$1.234` with `de-DE`; grams use decimal comma.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game logic/economy in `src/game.js`; German stage names, effects, strain notes, item/upgrade names+descriptions, German money/gram formatting.

# Weed Firm

Ein browserbasiertes Grow-Imperium im 3D-Growroom: Samen pflanzen, gießen, düngen, ernten und den Vorrat dann zum besten Marktpreis verkaufen. Die komplette Spieloberfläche ist auf Deutsch.

## Spielen

Das Projekt ist eine statische Website ohne Build-Schritt. Wegen der ES-Module braucht es einen kleinen Webserver:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3000
# danach http://localhost:3000 öffnen
```

Alternativ lässt sich der Ordner mit jedem anderen Static-Server ausliefern.

## Was drin ist

- **6 Töpfe** – drei sind von Anfang an frei, die restlichen drei kosten $900, $3.200 und $10.000.
- **32 Sorten** – von Northern Lights und Blue Dream über OG Kush, Gorilla Glue #4 und White Widow bis Gelato und Runtz. Jede Sorte hat THC-Gehalt, Typ, Wirkung, Wachstumszeit, Ertrag und eigenen Marktpreis.
- **Schnelle Freischaltungen** – das erste Level-up kommt nach wenigen Ernten, danach purzeln neue Genetiken im Minutentakt.
- **Samen & Dünger** – Samen werden beim Pflanzen verbraucht oder automatisch nachgekauft. Der Blüte-Booster gibt +30 % Wachstum und +6 % Qualität pro Zyklus.
- **Ausbau** – LED-Array, Nährstoff-Linie, Smart Pots, Sicherheit und Genetik-Labor mit insgesamt dutzenden Stufen.
- **Markt** – Preise bewegen sich alle sieben Sekunden. Wer die Spitze erwischt, verdient deutlich mehr.
- **Hitze & Razzien** – Ernten und Verkäufe erzeugen Hitze. Ab 100 % wird beschlagnahmt und kassiert. Sicherheit senkt beides.
- **Fortschritt** – Level- und XP-System, Statistiken, Autosave im Browser und Offline-Wachstum beim nächsten Besuch.
- **3D-Growroom** – Three.js mit prozeduralen Pflanzen, LED-Leisten, Neon-Schild, Staubpartikeln und sortenabhängigen Blütenfarben.
- **Mobil & Desktop** – touch-freundliche Marker, Slider-Panel und responsive Kamera für Hoch- und Querformat.

## Steuerung

| Aktion | Desktop | Mobil |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Topf auswählen | Topf im Raum oder in der Übersicht anklicken | Topf oder Marker antippen |
| Gießen / Ernten / Düngen | Buttons im Topf-Detail | Buttons im Topf-Detail |
| Tab wechseln | Tabs oder Tasten `1`–`4` | Tabs antippen |
| Detail schließen | `Esc` oder „Alle Töpfe“ | „Alle Töpfe“ |

Los geht es mit $320, zwei Blue-Dream-Samen, einem Northern-Lights-Samen, 3,4 g im Vorrat und einem reifen Blue-Dream-Topf. Der erste Verkauf finanziert in der Regel direkt den nächsten Samen.

## Tests

Die Spiellogik liegt bewusst getrennt in `src/game.js` und lässt sich ohne Browser testen:

```bash
npm test
```

Die Tests decken Pflanzen, Gießen, Düngen, Wachstum, Ernten, Verkaufen, Level-ups, Upgrades, Töpfe, Razzien, Marktdrift und Offline-Fortschritt ab.

## Technik

- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, kein Build-Schritt, keine Laufzeit-Abhängigkeiten.
- Three.js r160 liegt lokal unter `vendor/three.module.js`.
- Schriften liegen lokal unter `assets/fonts/`.
- Spielstand: `localStorage` (`weedfirm.save.v5`), automatisch alle fünf Sekunden und bei jeder Aktion.
- Zum Debuggen liegt der Zustand unter `window.__weedfirm = { state, scene, ui }`.

```
index.html          HUD, Start-Overlay, Tabs
styles.css          Layout, HUD, Startbildschirm
ui.css              Panels, Karten, Shop, Markt, Ausbau
src/game.js         Regeln, Wirtschaft, Sorten, XP, Markt, Razzien
src/scene.js        3D-Growroom, Pflanzen, Kamera, Marker
src/ui.js           UI-Controller, Aktionen, Toasts
src/panels.js       HTML für Anbau, Samen, Markt und Ausbau
src/icons.js        Inline-SVG-Icons
src/audio.js        WebAudio-Soundeffekte
src/main.js         Laden/Speichern, Offline-Wachstum, Loop
tests/game.test.mjs Tests der Spiellogik
```

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
